sentence: This project builds high-throughput assays in mice to study regulatory elements and disease-associated variants at different developmental time points and tissues.
This project develops a way to image radiotracers with Cerenkov luminescence imaging in ambient light instead of total darkness.
This project studies how the genes that control insect segmentation have changed during insect evolution and how they work.
This project uses machine learning to speed up the engineering of fluorescent protein sensors that detect calcium and neuromodulators in the brain.
This project develops a way to deliver nanobodies inside neurons to neutralize botulinum toxin and help recovery from botulism.
This project studies how genes, cells, tissues, organs and organisms work in human health and disease.
This project tries to build a nonhuman primate model of autism spectrum disorder by genetic modification of a gene often mutated in the disorder.
This project tests whether a transcriptional co-repressor changes how colorectal cancer cells adapt as the cancer spreads.
This project builds software tools that find microbial variants and strains in longitudinal microbiome samples and predict disease risk.
This project studies how T cells fight tumors and how tumors and immune cells send signals to each other.
This project studies how the body handles hydrogen sulfide and how it affects energy and oxygen metabolism.
This project runs genome sequencing and single cell analyses to find the genomic basis of normal and disrupted development in animal models.
This project uses artificial intelligence and dashboards to gather anonymous antimicrobial use information from veterinary records of dogs, cats and horses.
This project tries to develop a cell therapy for epilepsy that uses interneurons made from porcine embryonic neural progenitor cells.
This project studies which cellular factors let a virus enter cells and why it stays quiet in kidneys but causes fatal disease in glial cells.
This project builds kits with hands-on activities that teach physiology and health science.
This project provides tools to study single cells and tissue sections of the immune system, using cytometry by time-of-flight and imaging mass cytometry.
This project develops near-infrared fluorescence imaging probes that light up pancreatic cancer to guide surgery that removes it.
This project builds a navigation tool that uses computer vision and AI to guide people with pin-point accuracy.
This project tests a deep learning tool that helps read urine cytology samples to screen for bladder cancer.
